proof_body:
by
  intro F _ _ K u v hK hv
  rw [← norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hK hv]
  haveI : Nonempty K := ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
  have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun w : K => ‖u - w‖) := ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm (le_ciInf fun w => h w w.2) (ciInf_le hbdd ⟨v, hv⟩)
  · intro h w hw
    rw [h]
    exact ciInf_le hbdd ⟨w, hw⟩
target_source: ∀ (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (K : Set F) (u v : F), Convex ℝ K → v ∈ K → ((∀ w ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ ≤ ‖u - w‖) ↔ ∀ w ∈ K, inner ℝ (u - v) (w - v) ≤ 0)
